@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@ +

The two demo-seeder hint arms carry no raw email address — KS-2174 part 2, auth, log hygiene

+
What to know. The two services/auth/src/repositories/userRepo.ts demo-seeder log calls that carry a hint (Demo user NOT seeded and Demo user seeding skipped) now log userId instead of email; the KS-966 F2 cells in the KS-949 test find them by that id. To check it: npm --prefix Blockchain/Dev/services/auth test -- run src/__tests__/ks2174-demo-seeder-hint-arms-carry-no-raw-email.test.ts src/__tests__/ks949-platform-admin-seed-identity.test.ts. +

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@ +

. The two demo-seeder hint arms stop writing the raw email address into their meta (KS-2174 part 2, auth, log hygiene)

+
What this changes. The two demo-seeder log calls in services/auth/src/repositories/userRepo.ts that carry a hint (Demo user NOT seeded (no password supplied) ... and Demo user seeding skipped ..., lines 1764 and 1773 at develop 43d7eae7a5f8) logged email: account.email as a meta value; they now log userId: account.id, as part 1 (PR 2216) did for the other five seeder lines. The hint strings are unchanged. The KS-966 F2 cells in the KS-949 test found those two calls by meta['email'], so they now find them by meta['userId'] and the account id (a message-keyed find could not tell the two accounts apart, because both log the same message per arm). Log meta only: no auth decision, token, credential or database write changes. +
Proof. One new cell file, ks2174-demo-seeder-hint-arms-carry-no-raw-email.test.ts (four cells: three arm cells and one control on the instrument). Each arm cell first asserts its log line WAS reached, then that no meta value holds an email-shaped string, then that the calls name both no-password accounts by id. The three arm cells are RED on develop 43d7eae7a5f8 and green with the change; a planted email: account.email put back at the warn arm turns its two cells red again, and at the info arm turns its one cell red. With the product change alone, exactly four KS-949 F2 cells go red (so the two changes land together); with both, the KS-949 file reads 31 of 31, as before. The whole services/auth suite reads 150 files and 1,850 tests passed before and 151 files and 1,854 passed after. Measured on Node v26.8.1 (not the Node 24 LTS line), one Apple Silicon host, load1 2.5 to 3.3. +
Not claimed. With part 1 this covers the eight raw-email log sites KS-2174 names; the ninth, routes/users.ts line 678 (another open PR's handler), the services/auth/src/services/email.ts console lines, other log layers (the shared error handler, request logs), the dev-only url token and the hint strings are not changed. No live log was read, and no production log level or store was measured. +
